description: This Python script sets up a pipeline for heartbeat monitoring using the pipecat framework. It defines a NullProcessor class and runs a main async function that initializes and executes a pipeline with heartbeat monitoring enabled.

classes.name: NullProcessor
classes.description: A subclass of FrameProcessor that overrides process_frame to be asynchronous. It functions as a placeholder for frame processing within the pipeline.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Asynchronous method that processes a frame and direction, delegating to the superclass implementation.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Asynchronous main function that sets up a pipeline with heartbeat monitoring and runs it.

ctags.name: process_frame
ctags.pattern: /^    async def process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection):$/
